protocol.label: max_cycle - truncation_cycle (true, uncapped RUL; evaluation only)
protocol.features: built from the engine's own rows with cycle <= truncation_cycle; one prediction at the truncation cycle
protocol.training: full trajectories of the 80 V1 training engines, V1 hyperparameters; cap applied to training labels only
protocol.cv: 5-fold GroupKFold over the training engines, held-out fold engines truncated the same way

alternative_schedules.use: robustness checks only; same fitted models, no refit

phase2_reference.name: Phase 2 candidate (reference)
phase2_reference.notes: Saved Phase 2 model, features rebuilt from truncated history; reference only, not a contender

rules.primary: hold-out test-like MAE at least 3% lower than no cap
rules.secondary: hold-out test-like RMSE lower than no cap
rules.supporting: hold-out test-like R2 not lower than no cap
rules.robust_across_truncation: MAE lower at >= 3 of 4 truncation fractions
rules.robust_across_engines: engine-level bootstrap 95% CI of the MAE difference entirely below 0
rules.confirmed_on_training_engines: test-like 5-fold GroupKFold CV MAE on the 80 training engines lower than no cap
rules.low_rul_safety: MAE for true RUL <= 25 at most 2 cycles worse than no cap
rules.robust_to_truncation_schedule: MAE lower than no cap under BOTH alternative schedules (fractions 30-90 %, and 5 seeded uniform cuts in 30-95 % of life)
rules.no_band_degradation: pooled over all three schedules, no RUL band with >= 5 samples has MAE more than 2 cycles worse than no cap
rules.tie_break: lowest hold-out test-like MAE among caps that pass every rule
